name: Connect Hub
description: Use the apps connected through your Connect Hub MCP server.

methods.whenToUse: Use your self-hosted Connect Hub to reach the apps it manages.
methods.guidanceMd: Paste your Connect Hub MCP server URL (it ends in /mcp/s/<server id>) and sign in with your organization account when prompted. For a service setup, choose Bearer token under Advanced authentication and paste an MCP token issued by the hub.
methods.label: Connect MCP server
